project_title: BRUMA - Dark Mode Web Game Launcher & Client Platform

theme_strategy.theme: Tactical Cyber-Gothic Dark Matte with Electric Purple & Soft Lilac Highlights
theme_strategy.background_philosophy: Dark matte slate-black (#090a0f base, #12141d surface, #181b28 elevated card) with 1px purple-tinted subtle borders (#2e244d) and ambient purple glow behind hero actions.

layout_architecture.grid_structure: 3-column responsive desktop client layout with fixed header

elements: Left: Logo 'BRUMA' with glowing rune icon + status dot
Center: Search bar with glass blur, magnifying lens icon, shortcut hint 'Ctrl + K', dark search input
Right: Action tools - Message notifications icon with lilac badge, Notification bell icon with purple dot, Profile avatar with online halo ring & dropdown indicator

blocks.title: Friends Online

interactive_states_and_motion.library: framer-motion for page loads and card entrance transitions

animations.card_hover: scale: 1.02, translateY: -4px, shadow: glowing purple box-shadow
animations.progress_bar: smooth width transition on load using cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, badges) MUST have data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page or rich tabbed static interface for the BRUMA web game launcher matching dark mode client style.
Strictly follow the purple and lilac accent color palette (#8b5cf6, #c084fc, #6d28d9) over dark matte background (#090a0f).
Implement the left sidebar with active Home item, '2' purple badge on Friends, and bottom highlighted 'Go to library' button.
Implement the main hero section with 'magia da floresta' title, glowing artwork, dark purple 'descrição' button and lilac 'jogar' button.
Render 3 Indie Game vertical cards with image preview, game title, description, and purple 'descrição' button.
Implement right sidebar with 7 online friends and recently played games with purple progress bars.
Ensure all interactive buttons have hover scaling, smooth glow effects, and required data-testid attributes.
